ui.invalid: Not a valid choice, please try again.
setup.welcome: First use: let's set up ant-peer-review.
setup.backend.claude-cli: claude-cli — uses your Claude Code login (cheapest with a subscription)
setup.backend.anthropic-api: anthropic-api — Anthropic API key, pay per token (coming soon)
setup.backend_unavailable: {backend} is not available yet; please choose another.
setup.model_unavailable: Model {model} is unavailable and was not saved: {reason}
run.resume_choice: What would you like to do?
run.phase_skip: ✓ Phase {phase} already done, inputs unchanged — skipped
intake.targets_help: Enter targets, one per line: a URL (https://example.com/post), a folder or file path (./drafts), or paste text. Finish with /done on its own line, or press Enter twice.
intake.need_target: Please enter at least one target.
rubric.title: Scoring criteria and weights (total 100):
report.title: Review report
report.warn.fewer_than_two_reviewers: Fewer than 2 reviewers answered; findings are not cross-checked.
report.warn.single_vendor_correlated_err: All reviewers come from one vendor; their errors may be correlated, so agreement is not independent confirmation.
report.provisional: provisional: red lines await a ruling
report.scurve_not_scored: stage not verified, not scored (weight returned to Impact)
report.split_scores: Dimensions where reviewers' scores differ by 25 or more
report.label: Consensus
report.unverified: Findings set aside: they rest on unverified facts
report.injection_note: Untrusted original evidence below; it was withheld from reviewers. No flag does not prove there is no injection.
fc.later: Continue another time — save and exit
fc.finalize: Stop and finalize — compare with the last report
fc.unchanged: No fact changed since report v{v}: the report result is unchanged.
fc.updated: Facts changed: wrote report v{v} with a changelog.
fc.no_report: No report yet; finish the run first (ant-peer-review resume {run}).
decide.plan.A: Plan A — line edit (07-revision/A.md, diff in A.diff)
decide.plan.manual: Manual edit — I will provide my own final file
decide.manual_path: Path to your edited file (Enter = start from A.md as final.md):
decide.style_proposal: These corrections keep recurring for brand {brand}; add them to its Style Guide?
decide.style_confirm: Write these rules to the Style Guide?
lessons.second_time: Area {area} already has a lesson ({ids}). The same mistake twice should become a rule, not more text.
lessons.promote_hint: Consider turning it into a Style Guide rule or a default setting.
lessons.promote: Turn it into a site rule?
lessons.promote.ua: Set a user agent for this site
lessons.rule: Rule (what to do from now on):
intake.brand: Brand name for the Style Guide (Enter to skip):
sources.lesson_hint: tip: if this site keeps failing ({reason}), record it: ant-peer-review lessons new "<title>" --area crawl/<domain>
sources.failed: {n} target(s) could not be read. What now?
review.failed: These reviewers did not answer: {models}. What now?
review.without: Continue without them (disclosed in the report)
draft.again: Draft not good enough yet: writing round {round} with the findings as feedback.
decide.hint: Review done. To finish, run: ant-peer-review decide {run} --choice A|B|manual [--rule <red_line>=confirmed|dismissed]
run.interrupted: Interrupted; progress saved. Resume with: ant-peer-review resume {run}
ui.toggle_custom: Toggle numbers (e.g. 1 3), c = add a custom value, Enter to confirm (nothing ticked = skip):
run.delete_confirm: Delete {run} and its {n} file(s)? This cannot be undone.
ui.keys_radio: ↑↓ move · Enter choose · number keys pick directly · Esc cancel
ui.keys_multi: ↑↓ move · Space tick · Enter confirm · Esc cancel
feed.pick: This is a feed with {n} articles. Which ones should be reviewed? (each becomes its own run)
feed.picked: Feed: reviewing the newest {n} of {total} articles, one run each (change with --feed-limit)
revision.coverage: Coverage: plan A {a}, plan B {b}, both {both}, not handled {none} (07-revision/coverage.json)
